findings.quote: That banking seed saves real crop diversity, but only stays the safer insurance while the store can keep its accessions alive.
findings.note: Option-cluster tell, visible from form alone with zero domain knowledge: the three foils are each a recognisable non-thesis archetype - A is a flat overclaim ('every seed sample ... is one more crop variety insured'), C is a recommendation ('genebanks should give priority'), D is a bare process fact. B is the only option that states a thesis at all, and the only concessive 'X, but only while Y' construction. A main-idea stem plus exactly one two-part hedged option among absolutes decides the item without any passage.

findings.quote: and it would have gone on doing so without any limit at all, however large the collection grew
findings.note: Two form-only eliminations: B is an unbounded absolute no expository text would assert, and D swaps the axis of the stem (provenance of varieties rather than what happened as the collection grew). That leaves A vs C, a genuine both-sections/one-section contrast the passage must settle - materially better than chance but not decided.

findings.quote: It slipped slowly at low sizes but fell sharply once the collection passed about four times what one season could regenerate.
findings.note: Extremity gradient plus stem presupposition, both form-only. The stem names 'the sections where the collection outran its regeneration capacity', which presupposes a problem group; A ('barely changed at all') and D ('recovered over the years') contradict that presupposition, and B ('collapsed the moment') is an absolute. C is the sole graded answer and the only one carrying a specific quantified threshold - the standard key marker. No domain knowledge of genebanks is needed to run this elimination.

findings.quote: Because stored seed can never be kept alive at all unless every accession is grown out again each single season.
findings.note: B falls as a blanket 'can never ... unless every' absolute, and C is a generic process statement that does not address the contrast the stem asks about, so two options go on form. A ('happened to hold hardier crop species') remains a substantive confounding explanation, so the choice between A and D still needs the passage.

findings.quote: Broadly persuaded: she largely accepts Nystad's rule and treats the seed deaths as a minor gap that more regeneration plots will close.
findings.note: Redundant-option leak. A ('broadly persuaded ... largely accepts Nystad's rule') and C ('convinced: she shares Nystad's certainty') encode the same stance at different intensities; in a single-key item two options expressing the same position cannot be the answer, so both fall by pure logic. D is the extreme opposite ('dismissive ... too small to be worth the trouble'). B is what is left. This elimination uses no knowledge of genebanks whatsoever - it is readable from the option labels alone.

findings.quote: Varje fäbod som hörde till en brukad dalgård togs förr eller senare i bruk igen, oavsett trakt och stödform.
findings.note: Two form-only eliminations: C is a 'varje ... oavsett' absolute, and D offers the method (bevarade betesdagböcker) as the study's main result, a standard foil shape. A and B remain as the same association with the causal arrow reversed, and nothing in the stem or options settles the direction, so the passage is still needed.

findings.quote: Kopplingen till en gård i dalen gjorde fäbodarnas drift helt oberoende av om miljöersättningen fanns kvar eller inte.
findings.note: B falls as a 'helt oberoende' absolute and D reverses the stem's own direction of explanation (it explains the valley farm by the fäbod's economy, not the fäbod's survival by the farm link). A ('låg högre upp mot fjället') survives as a substantive alternative cause, so A vs C is not decided blind.

findings.quote: Fäbodlivet var genomgående så fattigt och slitsamt att all längtan tillbaka till det saknar grund.
findings.note: A ('borde återupprättas i stor skala') and C ('genomgående ... all längtan ... saknar grund') are the two extremes of the attitude scale and drop out on form. B and D are both balanced positions and D adds a further evaluative claim ('det var likväl riktigt att det till slut övergavs'), so the passage is genuinely required to choose between them.

findings.quote: Vilka fäbodar som återuppstod avgjordes mer av vem som betalade arbetet än av husens skick, och historien bör läsas nyktert.
findings.note: Structural leak on a 'huvudbudskap' stem: A offers the method as the message, B is an 'alltid ... oavsett' absolute, C introduces a comparison (storskaligt mjölkjordbruk) on an axis no other part of the item touches. D is the only two-clause synthesis and the only option that pairs a finding with a stance - the same lone-synthesis tell that decides a summary item with no reading and no knowledge of fäbod farming.
